steps.action: Receive parent verified candidate commit/tree, independent SOURCE disposition, publication verification, approved common Claude model/effort and prerequisite results; verify exact candidate content. Never substitute main or old evidence candidate.

Receive successful common API auth procedure; use secret only by parent-approved runtime method. Do not inspect, copy or log credentials; do not change permanent authentication, permissions or network policy.

Prepare isolated session-only candidate plugin/runtime and approved settings from parent. Preserve all candidate/source/generated bytes, hash manifests and workspace baseline. Confirm no unauthorized JEV, retry or model fallback path.

Freeze exact base prompt bytes, case variant base, rubric/oracle and available diff provenance before call. Keep expected answers and old failures out of Claude task context. If no fixed diff is supplied, preserve original missing-diff hold condition; do not invent a diff.

Receive exact original SS05 prompt and source-grounded context; inspect complete installed skill inventory under verified candidate and approved classification route. Preserve negative instructions. Any JEV path remains disabled until separately assigned.

Make actual final skill selection with authentic current actor/session/task hook observations. Collect exact selected IDs, reasons and accepted host record. Recommended IDs or self-report do not count as selection. Null remains null until observed.

Read actually selected SKILL.md and relevant references. If a complete immutable diff exists, perform read-only CR and CS review of lock release/cancellation. If absent or truncated, defer actual review and retain recommendations; do not implement or write tests.

Record selected/read/applied/verified independently from real host events tied to candidate, input, actor/task and artifact hashes. Compare frozen required CR+CS+O, forbidden P/T, action restrictions, actual review coverage and exclusions; never label code review independent audit PASS.

After every paid attempt, collect total cost, tokens, cache creation/read, retries, failure costs and unknown consumption. Stop before next call if budget approaches limit, is exhausted or remaining spend cannot be bounded. Sanitize only derived evidence; preserve failures and NOT_RUN.
